item.title: IDC Forecasts 60% of Enterprise AI Workloads on Open Models by 2028
item.description:
IDC's FutureScape 2027 report predicts that by 2028, 60% of enterprises will run their AI workloads on open-source models to reduce costs and avoid vendor lock-in. Additionally, it forecasts that 60% of G2000 companies will adopt an 'AI-first' approach for business processes by 2029, while emphasizing the need for agent kill switches to mitigate compliance risks.

原文标题：IDC 预测：2028 年六成企业 AI 负载将运行于开源模型

Why it matters：该预测揭示了企业级 AI 基础设施从专有模型向开源生态迁移的关键趋势，对技术选型与成本策略具有直接指导意义。

item.title: Tsinghua & Microsoft Propose HarnessMM: Pre-planned Agent Steps Cut Token Use by ~90%
item.description:
A joint study by Tsinghua University and Microsoft introduces HarnessMM, a framework where the model pre-writes future commands with validation checks. If tool results pass these checks, the agent executes directly without re-invoking the LLM. On HumanEval tasks, this approach reduced DeepSeek Harness's token usage by 87.93% while increasing success rates from 71.43% to 85.71%, significantly optimizing agent efficiency and cost.

原文标题：清华微软提出 HarnessMM：智能体预规划跳过冗余 LLM 调用，Token 省近九成

Why it matters：该研究提供了智能体架构中减少冗余 LLM 调用的具体工程范式，数据详实且对开发者具有直接的落地参考价值。

item.title: Turkey Launches Probe into Google Search AI Features with Interim Measures
item.description:
The Turkish Competition Authority has launched an investigation into Google's 'AI Overviews' and 'AI Mode' to determine if they violate competition laws by harming publisher traffic or engaging in exclusionary practices. Citing preliminary signs of exploitation, the authority has imposed interim measures regulating how Google uses publisher content in its AI-driven search.

item.description:

item.title: Minecraft Agent Swarm Test: Collaboration Bureaucratic, GPT Wins Battles
item.description:
Researchers from Y Combinator and Olam Labs tested hundreds of AI agents in Minecraft for collaboration and combat. Results showed that multi-agent collaboration often devolves into inefficient 'bureaucracy,' while GPT-6.1 Sol swarms defeated Claude Opus 5.5 clusters in PvP due to aggressive, hive-mind strategies. The open-source study aims to reveal behavioral patterns of agent swarms relevant to real-world applications.

原文标题：Minecraft 智能体集群测试：协作易官僚化，GPT 对战胜率高

Why it matters：提供了关于多智能体系统（MAS）在复杂环境中行为模式的实证数据，特别是揭示了协作瓶颈与不同模型架构在对抗中的策略差异，对 Agent 开发者具有较高参考价值。

item.title: Brazilian Lawyers Fined for Prompt Injection Attack on Court AI
item.description:
Two Brazilian lawyers were fined $16,000 for embedding hidden white-on-white text in legal filings to manipulate a court's AI system via prompt injection. Although the attack failed to alter the outcome (the plaintiff won by default), the court deemed it a violation of judicial dignity. This case highlights emerging security and ethical risks as AI tools are integrated into legal proceedings.

原文标题：巴西律师因提示词注入操纵法院 AI 被罚 1.6 万美元

Why it matters：揭示了生成式 AI 在垂直行业落地时面临的对抗性攻击风险与监管空白，具有警示意义。
